description: North-Western Provincial Council - Notify the North Western Provincial Ayurveda and Indigenous Medicine Statute, No. 09 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a provincial statute (North Western Provincial Ayurveda and Indigenous Medicine Statute No. 09 of 2017) that establishes a legal and regulatory framework for Ayurvedic and indigenous medicine practices in the North Western Province. It creates new regulations, establishes departments and committees, and outlines policy implementation - all characteristic of Legal/Regulatory gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a provincial ministry, this is contextual rather than the main focus, and there are no government personnel changes or detailed portfolio assignments that would make it a government-related type.
